newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela heating oil flexibility limited - official.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela heating oil flexibility limited - official.

text.p: Venezuela's capacity to respond to U.S. Energy Secretary Hazel O'Leary's call for more heating oil exports is limited by refinery flexibility, a top Venezuelan oil official said Wednesday.
"There is a limited capacity to absorb this demand," Simon Antunez, director of technology at the Energy and Mines Ministry, told a news conference.
The limited flexibility to raise distillate output is normally met from inventories, he added.
Venezuela tends to produce more distillates at this time of year than at others, Antunez said.
While not specifying Venezuela's distillates capacity Antunez said medium distillates account for between 15 and 20 percent of total refining capacity.

Venezuela has a crude refining capacity of 1.2 million barrels per day (bpd) and shipped an average of 58,000 bpd of heating oil and diesel fuel to the United States last year, according to U.S. Department of Energy data.
